description: Which of a route's points and legs lie outside the United States, each leg checked every 2 nm along its geodesic, and the Brief's one line for them. Every rule the engine holds is the FAA's: part 91 governs flight within the United States and the waters within 3 nm of its coast, most of its flight rules on to 12 nm (14 CFR 91.1(a), (b)); outside it a U.S. airplane flies by the foreign country's rules, and by ICAO Annex 2 over the high seas (14 CFR 91.703(a)). From Natural Earth's admin-0 countries at 1:50m (public domain), the United States with its territories and Canada, Mexico and the Bahamas; a point on no country's land is its nearest country's within 12 nm of its outline, else other. Warn, never limit (decision 0053).

name.description: Its name as the pilot reads it, "KBUF": the warnings name the point and the leg to it by it; "This point" and "The leg" without one.

points.description: The route's points in order, the nav log's departure, stops and destination: a leg from each to the next.

code.description: US: the United States with its territories (14 CFR 1.1); CA Canada, MX Mexico, BS the Bahamas; other anywhere else, the high seas among it.

caution.description: The warning at a point outside the United States, "CYQT is in Canada (Ontario): Canadian rules not checked — figures use US rules"; null in the United States.

items.description: US: the United States with its territories (14 CFR 1.1); CA Canada, MX Mexico, BS the Bahamas; other anywhere else, the high seas among it.

codes.description: The countries other than the United States met along the leg, its ends included, in the order met.

caution.description: The leg's own warning where it meets a country, or a province of Canada, neither of its ends is in, named by where it goes and where it crosses, "The leg to KBUF crosses Canada (Ontario): Canadian rules not checked — figures use US rules"; null otherwise (a leg into a field in Canada is said at the field).

legs.description: From each point to the next.

items.description: US: the United States with its territories (14 CFR 1.1); CA Canada, MX Mexico, BS the Bahamas; other anywhere else, the high seas among it.

outside.description: Every country other than the United States the route meets, once each in order.

lead.description: The finding alone, "Part of the route is in Canada (Ontario): Canadian rules not checked — figures use US rules".

line.description: The finding and what to do, in one line.

brief.description: The Brief's line for the route, once; null where it is all in the United States.
